description: Calculate the Vedic panchang (Hindu almanac) of a day at a place with Moon Dasha: the weekday; tithi, nakshatra, yoga and karana with their change times; the Moon's sign; the lunar month (Amanta and Purnimanta); sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset; Rahu Kaal, Gulikai Kalam, Yamaganda, Dur Muhurtam, Abhijit Muhurat, Vijaya Muhurta, Amrit Kalam and Brahma Muhurta; the 24 horas; planets changing sign or nakshatra that day; and when the next Purnima, Amavasya and Ekadashis run. No Choghadiya or festival dates. Needs the place (a place_id from find_place); the date defaults to today there, and the answer then also says what is running now. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

sunrise.description: Which sunrise opens the day: apparent (the default, as moondasha.com times it: the upper limb with refraction) or classical (the centre of the disc on the true horizon, without refraction).
